description: Gets a layout device by name, or the default device when name is omitted. On a headless site there is usually only the Default device.

fields.description: Extra Sitecore field names to include, e.g. ['Title']. Ignored when full is true.

full.description: Return the unprojected .NET object graph. Very large (100,000+ chars/item); diagnostics only.

name.description: Name of the device to return, e.g. 'Default'. Omit for the default device.

name: presentation-get-layout-device
